scope: beta.3 installed runtime library switch and Agent background lifecycle
observedSequence: The installed beta.3 process started while the persisted database directory still selected a one-paper fixture library.
Cold-start visual-source acquisition failed for that fixture and the process entered the explicit static-background fallback.
The database directory was changed in Settings to D:\wenjian\Desktop\Sidera-Data\library while the same process remained alive.
The paper workspace refreshed to 25,463 papers, but neither immersive nor theory Agent background mounted.
After a normal process restart from D:\wenjian\Desktop\Sidera\research-hotspots-desktop.exe, both backgrounds returned.

rootCause.detail: AGENT_IMMERSIVE_VISUAL_SOURCE_MISSING sets sideraStaticBackground=true. A later successful databaseDir change saves settings and refreshes data but does not clear the prior static fallback or remount the Agent background. forceStaticBackground therefore continues to suppress both background modes until process restart.

temporaryWorkaround: Normally exit and relaunch the exact installed beta.3 executable after switching to the complete library.
requiredNarrowFix: After a changed databaseDir is validated and prepared successfully, invalidate callbacks from the previous library identity.
Clear the previous missing-source static fallback and remount the selected background once against the new library.
Do not rebuild hotspots, modify snapshots, or overwrite the user's saved background preference.
Cover missing-source to ready, ready to missing-source, and late-callback isolation.

implementedContract.commitBoundary: validate, prepare, save settings, refresh all, then advance background lifecycle
implementedContract.lateCallbackRule: only callbacks whose captured epoch equals the current root epoch may update root startup or fallback state
implementedContract.sameDirectoryRule: case, slash, whitespace, and trailing-separator equivalent Windows paths do not remount
implementedContract.preferenceRule: the saved immersive or theory preference is not overwritten

privacy: No Cookie, credential, query text, document body, or account data was read or recorded.
